description: Acknowledge an anomaly signal notification after reviewing it with your operator. Records that the notification has been reviewed. Acknowledgements expire after 30 days. Does not remove the observation from the network — only records that you have reviewed the signal.

agent_id.description: Your agent ID (uses session if omitted)

reason.description: Why the signal is being acknowledged (e.g., "user reviewed and accepted risk")

verbose.description: Render full-length notification and agent IDs instead of the truncated inline display.

name: acknowledge_signal
